title: QA Engineer
description:
About The Role
Sitech is looking for a QA Engineer to support the quality assurance efforts for our digital products. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and executing test scenarios, identifying defects, and ensuring the delivery of reliable, high-quality solutions. You will collaborate closely with developers, product teams, and stakeholders to understand requirements, validate functionality, and continuously improve the overall quality of our products.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze functional requirements and identify test scenarios, test cases, and basic edge cases.
Perform functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, and exploratory testing for web and mobile applications.
Execute complete testing cycles to ensure product quality before release.
Perform basic API testing using tools such as Postman to validate integrations and backend functionality.
Conduct cross-browser UI testing to ensure consistent user experience across different platforms.
Report, track, and manage defects using Jira, ensuring proper documentation and follow-up with development teams.
Maintain test documentation and test execution records using tools such as AIO, Zephyr, or TestRail.
Participate in requirement discussions, sprint activities, and team meetings to ensure quality considerations are addressed early.
Collaborate with developers, product owners, and team members to investigate issues and validate fixes.
Contribute to improving QA processes, testing practices, and team collaboration.
Qualifications & Skills
1–2 years of proven experience in Quality Assurance testing.
Good understanding of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and software development processes.
Hands-on experience with functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing.
Basic experience in API testing using Postman, including collections and environments.
Experience using Jira for defect tracking and test management.
Familiarity with test management tools such as AIO, Zephyr, or TestRail.
Experience documenting test cases, test results, and requirements using Confluence or similar documentation tools.
Ability to analyze requirements, understand business workflows, and identify potential quality risks.
Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and problem-solving mindset.
Good communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within Agile teams.
ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL) - preferred.

A QA & Software Testing Specialist is responsible for maintaining software quality by identifying and resolving defects in applications. About The Role

The
Senior Quality Assurance (QA) Officer
is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and stability of software products through thorough testing and validation. This role involves designing and executing both manual and automated test plans, identifying defects, and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams—including development, product management, and operations—to deliver high-quality solutions.
Additionally, the Senior QA Officer mentors junior team members, drives continuous process improvements, and actively contributes to the development and execution of the overall QA strategy.

Conduct complex quality assurance tests and inspections to validate software functionality, performance, and compliance with requirements.
Develop and execute detailed test plans and test cases that cover all functional and non-functional aspects of the product.
Analyze test results, identify defects, and track issues through to resolution, ensuring timely fixes and verification.
Collaborate closely with development teams to integrate quality practices throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
Review and approve quality-related documentation, including test reports, defect logs, and user manuals.
Provide technical expertise, mentorship, and guidance to junior QA team members to build their skills and improve overall team performance.
Participate actively in continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing QA processes, methodologies, and tools.
Assist in risk assessment and mitigation by identifying potential quality risks early in the project lifecycle.
Help define and enforce QA best practices and standards within the team and organization.
Support audit and compliance activities by preparing documentation and demonstrating adherence to standards.
Stay updated on industry trends and emerging QA tools to recommend innovations that improve quality and efficiency.
Assist in training and onboarding new QA team members to accelerate their integration and effectiveness.
Prepare and present detailed test summary reports that communicate testing outcomes, defect status, and quality risks to project stakeholders.
Track and report progress of automation efforts, including coverage, execution rates, and defect detection efficiency.
Ensure compliance with institutional policies, academic standards, and regulatory guidelines.
Perform any additional relevant tasks assigned by the direct manager.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
4-6 years of experience in a related field.
ISTQB Foundation Level or Advanced Level - Test Analyst/Test Manager is plus
Relevant certifications in automation tools (e.g., Selenium, JMeter, Postman) is plus
English

Experience in Microsoft suite Office.
Experience in Collaboration

Skilled in performing both manual and automated testing across web, mobile, and API platforms to ensure
comprehensive coverage.

description:

MS Pharma is a leading pharmaceutical company specializing in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of generic and biosimilar medicines. Founded in 1989, with headquarters in Amman, Jordan and a Corporate Management Office in Zug, Switzerland, MS Pharma operates across 12 countries with more than 2,000 employees serving patients throughout the Middle East, North Africa, and selected European markets.
Description
Ensure implementation of Quality Assurance QA policies and procedures to ensures that all products in United Pharmaceutical are manufactured according to GMP rules in all production stages and that all tests needed for final release are complete and accurate through daily observation, review and approve batch records.

Supervise IPC tests during manufacturing and packaging to ensure products conform to specifications, overseeing line clearance, cleaning validation, and bulk/final product sampling.
Approve/reject general cleaning in production areas and supervise product transitions between stages, ensuring adherence to cGMP and SOPs.
Review and QA SOPs, ensuring compliance with good documentation practices and cGMP requirements.
Ensure all SOPs and logbooks in production areas are up to date, valid, and followed properly.
Oversee the destruction of rejected products in compliance with SOP and cGMP standards.
Receive and assess deviations, manage deviation cycles, and identify CAPAs to resolve issues.
Lead investigations into production failures and OOS cases, identifying root causes and ensuring implementation of CAPAs.
Approve/reject resumption of production after maintenance and coordinate deviation reports and CAPA implementation.
Assess and approve change control requests, following up on the implementation of any necessary changes.
Manage complaints investigations, identifying corrective actions to prevent future recurrence.
Oversee batch records during production, ensuring completion and adherence to cGMP and SOPs.
Review and give final approval of batch records as delegated by the QA Manager.
Arrange and perform self-inspections to ensure compliance with quality standards.
Assist in preparing for external audits and implement corrective actions resulting from audit findings.
Conducting periodic meetings with team members regarding work priorities and ensuring work is progress smooth and inform team of company updates, departmental changes … etc.”
Manage team’s personnel affairs (leaves, vacations…etc.), performance management, coaching and needed training.
Ensure compliance with relevant national and international health, safety and environmental laws and policies as well as maintain the records and reports of HSE aspects.
Education
B.Sc. degree in Pharmacy, chemical Engineering or in any scientific field
Experience
A minimum 6 years experience in QA department.
Language
Proficiency in written, read and spoken Arabic and English languages

description:
Build your quality career inside a fast-expanding techno-commercial business.
element is hiring for a high-growth client in the lifting solutions industry — a fast-expanding, techno-commercial business supporting critical sectors such as energy, oil & gas, marine, construction, infrastructure, material handling and industrial projects.
This is a business where technical knowledge, commercial speed, and operational reliability come together. The company is growing its market presence, strengthening its systems, and building the next layer of technical and operational talent.
We are looking for a
QA
/QC Officer / Engineer
who wants to grow with that journey.
This is not a routine inspection role. It is an opportunity to work in a safety-critical industry, build deeper exposure to lifting and rigging solutions, strengthen quality systems, and contribute to a business where every product, certificate, inspection, and release carries real responsibility.
Why this role matters
In lifting solutions, quality is not just a department.
It is the difference between accepted and rejected.
Between compliant and exposed.
Between trusted and questioned.
Between safe lifting and serious risk.
The QA/QC Officer / Engineer will play a key role in ensuring that materials, products, inspections, testing records, certification documents, and quality processes are accurate, traceable, and aligned with customer, technical, and regulatory requirements.
You will help the business move faster — but correctly.
You will help teams deliver — but safely.
You will help growth happen — without quality becoming the weak link.
What you will do
Quality inspection and control
Conduct incoming, in-process and final inspections of materials, products and assemblies.
Inspect lifting and rigging-related products such as wire ropes, slings, shackles, lifting accessories, sockets, webbing products, chain slings and material handling components.
Verify dimensions, markings, WLL / SWL details, identification tags, batch details, heat numbers, certificates and customer-specific requirements.
Monitor quality during fabrication, assembly, swaging, socketing, splicing, testing, tagging, packing and dispatch.
Identify non-conforming materials, products or processes before they impact safety, delivery or customer trust.
Testing, certification, and traceability
Coordinate inspection and testing activities with internal teams, third-party inspectors, laboratories, clients, and consultants where required.
Review inspection reports, test certificates, conformity certificates, and customer documentation before product release.
Maintain complete traceability from material receipt to finished product dispatch.
Ensure product identification, labels, serial numbers, batch numbers, and certificates are accurate and aligned.
Track calibration status of measuring instruments, inspection tools, and testing equipment.
Quality systems and documentation
Support the implementation and maintenance of ISO-based quality management practices.
Maintain inspection reports, NCRs, corrective action records, calibration certificates, audit reports, quality checklists and customer quality documentation.
Prepare quality reports covering inspection status, NCR trends, rework, corrective actions, audit findings and improvement opportunities.
Support internal audits, customer audits, third-party audits and certification body audits.
Ensure quality records are complete, controlled, traceable and audit-ready.
Non-conformance and improvement
Raise, track and close Non-Conformance Reports.
Investigate root causes of defects, deviations, rework, customer complaints and recurring quality issues.
Coordinate corrective and preventive actions with production, stores, procurement, testing, inspection and project teams.
Verify that rework, repair or rectification is completed in line with required standards.
Recommend practical improvements that reduce errors, rework, delays and cost of poor quality.
Cross-functional coordination
Work closely with production, testing, inspection, stores, procurement, planning, HSE, project and dispatch teams.
Liaise with clients, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers and third-party inspectors on quality matters.
Communicate quality risks clearly, professionally and with supporting evidence.
Support project and delivery teams without compromising quality standards.
Help build a culture where quality is owned by everyone, not parked neatly in a file after the job is done.
What makes this opportunity exciting
This role sits inside a business that is moving fast and building for the next stage of growth.
You Will Gain Hands-on Exposure To
Lifting, rigging and wire rope solutions.
Energy, industrial and project-driven customer requirements.
Product inspection, testing and certification.
ISO-based quality management systems.
Customer and third-party inspections.
Calibration, traceability and quality documentation.
NCR, CAPA, audits and continuous improvement.
Workshop, site and project-based quality control.
For the right person, this can grow into broader responsibility across quality systems, inspection coordination, supplier quality, audits, technical documentation, process improvement and quality leadership.
This is a role for someone who does not just want to check quality.
It is for someone who wants to build it.
What we are looking for
Bachelor's degree or diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Civil Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality or a related technical discipline.
2–5 years of QA/QC experience in manufacturing, fabrication, lifting equipment, rigging, wire rope, construction, engineering, industrial or energy-related environments.
Hands-on experience in inspection, testing, product verification and quality documentation.
Working knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management systems.
Experience in material inspection, supplier documentation review, NCR management and corrective action follow-up.
Ability to understand drawings, technical specifications, inspection requirements and customer documentation.
Proficiency in MS Office, especially Excel, Word and Outlook.
Experience that will give you an advantage
Exposure to lifting equipment, rigging, wire ropes, slings, shackles, sockets, hoists, cranes or material handling products.
Experience with customer inspections, third-party inspections or certification documentation.
Knowledge of calibration requirements for measuring tools and testing equipment.
Certification in ISO 9001 Internal Auditor / Lead Auditor.
Additional certification in QA/QC, welding inspection, lifting equipment inspection, NDT, calibration or material testing.
Familiarity with Energy / Oil & Gas customer requirements will be preferred.
The person who will succeed here
You Notice What Others Miss.
The unclear marking.
The missing certificate.
The wrong tag.
The expired calibration record.
The incomplete traceability.
The small deviation could become a major issue later.
You are practical, structured, and calm under pressure. You know how to support production and project teams without slowing the business down unnecessarily, but you also know when to hold the line.
You believe quality should help the business move faster, safer and smarter.
Why join this opportunity?
Because this is not a static QA/QC role in a slow-moving setup.
This is a chance to join a growing techno-commercial business at a stage where quality systems, technical capability and operational discipline are becoming even more important to future growth.
You will work close to the action, learn from experienced technical teams, support customer-facing quality requirements and build expertise in a sector where quality has real business impact.
If you are looking for a role where your work matters, your learning curve is strong and your career can grow with the business, this is a serious opportunity.

Comfortable working in fast-paced environments using Jira and participating actively in Scrum ceremonies

Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects

description:

SUMMARY
The Software Quality Engineer is responsible for improving and ensuring software quality, stability and release confidence by validating customer workflows, identifying risks, collaborating with Product and Engineering teams, and applying effective testing strategies across software applications.
This role plays a critical part in testing new features, performing exploratory testing, and ensuring that test coverage meets business and technical requirements. With a primary focus in manual testing, this role will also perform basic automation scripting for regression testing in order to improve efficiency where necessary.
Our tech stack includes HTML5/CSS, Node.js, React, TypeScript, C#, Python, JavaScript, Docker, AWS, and Azure Services, along with databases such as MS-SQL, PostgreSQL, and Snowflake.
KEY OUTCOMES & RESPONSIBILITIES
Key Outcome
:
Comprehensive Test Coverage and High-Quality Software Releases
Key Responsibilities:
Manual Testing Execution: Perform functional, exploratory, regression, and user acceptance testing to validate software functionality.
Test Case Design & Documentation: Develop effective validation approaches, reusable QA coverage, and documentation based on business requirements, technical requirements, and product risk.
Bug Tracking & Reporting: Identify, document, and prioritize defects, providing detailed reports to developers to ensure timely fixes.
Cross-Browser and Device Testing: Ensure applications work across different devices, browsers including Edge, Chrome, Firefox and others, and operating systems such as Windows & MacOS.
End-to-End Testing: Validate end-to-end customer workflows, data integrity, integrations, business rules, and data flows across connected systems.
Automation for Regression Coverage: Contribute to automation coverage by identifying opportunities where automation provides meaningful value and maintaining reliable automated tests that improve testing efficiency.
Collaboration with Developers: Work closely with software engineers to reproduce issues and verify fixes.
Key Outcome: Efficient Testing Processes and Continuous Improvement
Key Responsibilities:
Work Closely with Product and Engineering Teams: Understand business requirements and acceptance criteria to create effective test cases.
Improve Testing Strategies: Identify opportunities for improving manual testing efficiency and propose automation where beneficial.
Maintain Testing Documentation: Keep detailed records of test cases, results, and defect reports.
Support Release Readiness: Conduct final checks before production releases and participate in go/no-go decisions.
Stay Updated on QA Best Practices: Learn and adopt new testing techniques and methodologies as needed.
REQUIREMENTS
REQUIRED-
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.
3-5 years of experience in software testing.
Strong ability to analyze requirements, identify quality risks, define effective validation approaches, and communicate findings.
Experience using bug tracking and test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar).
Experience validating APIs, integrations, data flows, and system interactions using appropriate testing tools.
Experience contributing to automated testing solutions using frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar technologies.
PREFERRED-
Experience with SQL for database validation and data integrity testing.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and testing in an Agile/Scrum environment.
Knowledge of performance testing concepts and tools (e.g., JMeter, k6).
Some experience with version control tools like Git.
CORE COMPETENCIES
CUSTOMER FOCUS/CLIENT INTIMACY: seeking to understand client business challenges/needs and delivering continuous value to our clients
COLLABORATIVE: working with teams and across the organization with ease
OWNER AGILITY: able to continuously learn and quickly adapt to changing circumstance
RESULTS DRIVEN: accepts accountability to deliver business outcomes, even under changing circumstances. Delivers on commitments
DISCIPLINED: Thinks, plans, and prioritizes work on an ongoing basis, plans and aligns with key team members before acting
Travel Requirements
All employees, regardless of role or geographic location, are required to attend in person for onboarding during their first week of employment and annually for the Shareholder’s Summit held in June. Additional travel is not routinely expected but may be required for key/critical meetings & events
WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS

title: QA Engineer
description:
About The Job
Our mission
Boom is on a mission to level the playing field for the 110+ million renters in the US by making housing more flexible, affordable, and rewarding. Boom is building a suite of rental financial services for renters and property managers, including tenant screening, rent payment reporting, rent reporting-as-a-service, and a number of integrations with the largest property management systems (PMS). Boom serves renters through the Boom App and property managers via the Boom Platform. Now serving thousands of renters, Boom is led by second-time founder Rob Whiting (ex-BCG, Rubicon). It's backed by investors such as Starting Line, Clocktower Ventures, Gilgamesh Ventures (Petal co-founders), and angels such as William Hockey and Zach Perret (Co-founders of Plaid) and Harry Stebbings. Boom has been profiled by Inman, Business Insider, HousingWire, and more.
Opportunity
The QA Engineer owns product quality, reliability, and consistency across the Boom platform. You'll run manual and exploratory testing, identify bugs, and verify quality across web, mobile, and our integrations, with a focus on customer impact, edge cases, and release readiness.
At Boom, quality directly affects property manager trust and renter experience. A payment that fails, a report that breaks, or a workflow that confuses users erodes confidence fast. You'll partner closely with product, engineering, and customer success to catch issues before they reach customers, document clean reproduction steps, and advocate for the fixes that matter most.
This is a hands-on testing role for someone who enjoys breaking things to make them better and thrives in a fast-paced environment. For this role, we are hiring for candidates in Austin, TX, where our leadership and product team is located. Comp range listed is directional and adjustable +/- based on competency.
What You'll Do
Run manual and exploratory testing across new features, regressions, and edge cases. Validate behavior across browsers, operating systems, and mobile devices
Test third-party integrations (payment processors, accounting systems, banking partners) for data accuracy and reliability
Own final QA sign-off for production releases. Critical paths work or we don't ship
Maintain regression suites and catch unintended side effects from new code or config changes
Write clear, reproducible bug reports with screenshots, repro steps, expected vs actual behavior, and severity. Verify fixes in staging and production
Partner with PMs and engineers to clarify requirements, reproduce issues, and ship customer-focused tests grounded in real user workflows
Maintain test cases, checklists, and QA standards so quality holds up as we scale
What You'll Need
2+ years of QA or software testing experience, ideally on web and mobile in SaaS or fintech
Strong analytical instincts. You assess product behavior beyond the documented acceptance criteria and proactively clarify requirements when they're vague or incomplete
Clean, structured bug reports are second nature: repro steps, screenshots, severity, expected vs actual
Comfortable with browser dev tools, network inspection, basic debugging, and API integration testing
Daily use of AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) for test case generation, exploratory testing, and scripting. We use AI heavily across the team and expect new hires to do the same
Balance thoroughness with speed in a fast-moving startup environment
Strong written communicator who collaborates cross-functionally with product and engineering
Plus: experience testing payment flows, financial systems, or compliance-sensitive features; exposure to test automation or scripting
Empathy for our end users, including low-to-moderate-income renters, and a desire to build products that make a difference
Benefits Of Working At Boom
Competitive salary with stock options
Full healthcare coverage (health, dental, vision) including 50% coverage for dependents
15 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year + 3 sick days + all US federal holidays (11 in total) (note: we think unlimited PTO is BS and causes some employees to feel guilty when they take it)
Company-issued laptop/MacBook
Company-sponsored training & development
Regular off-sites, retreats, and other company-sponsored events and travel opportunities

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
About Boost Payment Solutions
Boost Payment Solutions is transforming B2B payments through secure, cloud-native platforms for payment processing, payment facilitation, settlement, and enterprise payment workflows. Our technology moves mission-critical financial transactions where reliability, accuracy, and security are non-negotiable.
About the Role
You will join a Quality Engineering function that is being rebuilt, not maintained.
We are migrating an existing Selenium suite to Playwright, standing up scenario-first regression coverage across Gen-3 payment processing, email and file parsing, and PayFac settlement, and wiring it into GitHub Actions so quality signal appears on every pull request. You will write automation daily, use AI tooling to accelerate test creation and migration, and own real coverage on a platform that processes live money.
If you are looking for a mature suite to maintain, this is not that role. If you want to build one, it is.
Why this role matters
You own measurable regression coverage on mission-critical B2B payment flows — not a slice of someone else’s suite.
You work across the full stack of quality signal: UI, API, database validation, and CI pipeline health.
You use AI tooling in production practice, not as an experiment — with review standards that keep it trustworthy.
What You’ll Do
Automation & Framework Contribution
Build and maintain automated tests in our Playwright framework across UI, API, and end-to-end suites.
Contribute to the Selenium-to-Playwright migration using AI-assisted tooling (Kiro), reviewing all generated output before merge.
Keep tests running in GitHub Actions — improving stability, execution speed, and reporting while retiring flaky and low-value tests.
Follow the scenario-first design standard: one scenario, one fixed assertion set, so a failure names itself without an SME.
Test Execution, Coverage & Traceability
Execute functional, integration, end-to-end, and regression testing across payment processing, parsing, and settlement workflows.
Write and maintain test cases in AIO Test with traceability to Jira stories, acceptance criteria, automation, and defects.
Validate data end to end — write SQL against Postgres schemas to confirm parsing, enrichment, and reconciliation results, not just UI state.
Build regression coverage for high-volume email and file ingestion, payment APIs, and third-party integrations.
AI-Assisted Quality Engineering
Use AI tooling to generate, refactor, and maintain automated tests, test data scenarios, and failure analysis.
Review every AI-generated test for correctness, coverage, edge cases, security, and maintainability before it lands.
Operate within Boost’s AI usage, data-handling, and code review standards — no production or cardholder data in AI tooling.
Share what works and what doesn’t, so practice improves for the whole team rather than one engineer.
Release Quality, Environments & Reporting
Support release quality gates and promotion decisions with Engineering and DevOps, including evidence capture for each gate.
Apply repeatable test data and environment readiness practices — synthetic data, reusable accounts, controlled datasets, and refresh procedures.
Report quality metrics in binary terms: automation coverage, pass rate, defect leakage, and regression health — with numerator and denominator, not narrative.
Join backlog refinement, sprint planning, and release readiness reviews to surface coverage gaps and integration risk early.
What You Bring
Required
3–5 years in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or Software QA, with hands-on automation delivery in Agile or DevOps environments.
Working experience with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium across UI, API, and end-to-end automation.
Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript sufficient to write and maintain automation code independently. (Java, C#, or JavaScript backgrounds considered where the fundamentals are strong.)
Ability to write SQL for data validation — joins, aggregates, and result comparison against expected datasets.
Experience running automated tests in GitHub Actions or a comparable CI/CD pipeline.
Experience testing APIs, integrations, or cloud-native applications, and comfort reading logs to diagnose a failure before escalating it.
Clear written communication — able to state a quality risk in terms of business impact.
Preferred
Payments, fintech, banking, or PCI-regulated experience — settlement, funding, tokenization, or transaction platforms.
High-volume data ingestion or parsing validation (email, EDI, batch file, or similar structured feeds).
AWS experience — S3, Secrets Manager, Step Functions, or equivalent cloud-native testing exposure.
Hands-on use of AI-assisted tools for test creation, maintenance, or failure analysis.
Test management tooling (AIO Test, Xray, Zephyr), and experience working with distributed or offshore teams.
What we use
Automation
Playwright (migrating from Selenium) · Python · TypeScript
API & data
REST Assured / Postman · SQL against Postgres · S3 · Snowflake (in progress)
CI/CD
GitHub Actions — PR smoke gate, nightly full regression, post-deploy production smoke
Test management
AIO Test (Jira-native) · Jira · Confluence for strategy and evidence
AI tooling
Kiro for spec-driven test generation and Selenium-to-Playwright migration
Cloud
AWS — S3, Secrets Manager, Step Functions
What Success Looks Like in Your First Year
-
Area Expected impact
Coverage
Reliable automated coverage across the critical workflows, APIs, and integrations you own.
Speed
Tests run in CI on every PR and nightly
Traceability
Your test cases map cleanly to Jira stories, automation, and defects.

A meaningful share of your test creation and maintenance is AI-accelerated and reviewed to standard.
Our Hiring Process
Recruiter conversation — role, background, and logistics.
Hiring manager screen — your hands-on automation experience, in specifics.
Practical exercise — you will review an existing automated test, identify what is wrong with it, and propose improvements. We care how you think about test design, not whether you memorized syntax.

Why Boost
Direct impact on platform reliability, release confidence, and customer experience on live payment rails.
A quality function with executive sponsorship and a funded roadmap — not an afterthought.
Real exposure to cloud-native platforms, AI-enabled engineering practice, and modern delivery models.
Room to grow into senior quality engineering work as the function scales.
Compensation & equal opportunity

Demonstrated commitment to building strong and welcoming cultures that help to develop others

Performance Task

Reference Checks
Benefits
Compensation and Benefits
Braven offers competitive base salaries based on the midpoint of the market among not-for-profit organizations of similar size, with opportunities for salary growth over time. We believe in compensating staff members fairly in relation to each other, their qualifications, and their impact on behalf of the organization, and take internal and external equity seriously. Given our commitment to equity, Braven does not negotiate salary offers; instead, each salary offer is determined carefully using external and internal benchmarking.
Starting salary within the range is determined by role scope and qualifications, with new hires starting at the lower end to allow for growth with performance. Braven does not base compensation on individual candidate salary expectations and is committed to maintaining internal equity. The starting salary range for this role in Chicago is $92,000-$101,100. This is based on a 50-hour work week. This is a full-time, regular, exempt, and benefits eligible position where you will be working at 100% capacity.
Braven also provides competitive, comprehensive benefits, recognition, and career development. While Braven reserves the right to change benefits at any time, current benefits include:
Unlimited vacation time in addition to org-wide holidays and week-long shutdowns in July and the end of the calendar year (this is a minimum of 19 days per year)
Braven supports your path to parenthood and beyond with $25,000 in lifetime Carrot benefits for fertility, family-building, and hormonal health
Match of your 401K contribution up to 5% of your base annual salary, starting your first full month
Coverage of 85% of health insurance premium for employee and dependents
12 weeks of paid parental leave
A one-month paid sabbatical after 4 years on staff
Please note that Braven is firm in its compensation philosophy; therefore, only candidates who believe that our total rewards package matches what they are looking for in their next opportunity are encouraged to apply.
Location
We gather in the office 3 days a week (Tuesday through Thursday) and work remotely 2 days a week (Monday and Friday). Therefore, this role requires teammates to live within commuting distance of one of our hubs: Chicago. We believe in the magic, connection, and collaboration that happens when people work together face-to-face, and we believe in giving people flexibility to focus, balance personal priorities, and save themselves two commutes per week.
Braven is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected factor. We encourage talented individuals of all backgrounds to apply.

description:

Location: Dubai, UAE, on-site

Type: internship, Monday to Friday, 10 to 4, eight to twelve weeks
Compensation: unpaid, with a completion certificate subject to satisfactory performance
Future opportunity: high-performing interns may be considered for a paid role based on performance and company needs
About the role:
Elchai Group builds advanced digital platforms across AI infrastructure, real-world assets, legal AI, compliance-focused workflows, investor portals, and admin dashboards. These are complex, multi-step business systems, not simple websites. We are also building a voice-first AI business assistant that team members use through both a desktop and a browser app, so this role now includes testing spoken AI interactions as well. We are looking for a QA Tester Intern to help test all of these platforms before they reach users, investors, internal teams, and partners.
This role suits someone who wants practical experience in software testing, QA automation, AI-assisted testing, Playwright, API testing, voice interface testing, and product quality. This is not a basic manual testing internship. You should be willing to learn how to test complex products, including an AI voice assistant, using structured QA thinking, AI tools, browser testing, and clear documentation.
Key responsibilities:
Use AI tools to help generate and organize test cases, edge cases, and regression checklists.
Run manual and exploratory testing across dashboards, portals, admin panels, and user flows like sign-up, login, onboarding, forms, approvals, uploads, and downloads.
Check error, loading, and empty states, mobile responsiveness, and cross-browser behavior.
Support Playwright automation for login flows, form validation, role-based access, and multi-step workflows.
Test APIs and backend workflows, including response status, authentication, permissions, data consistency, and audit logs.
Perform boundary testing to confirm what the system should not allow, such as a normal user reaching admin pages or seeing another user's private records.
Test the voice assistant, including whether it correctly hears speech in multi languages, whether it speaks answers back cleanly, and whether interruption and resume behave properly.
Test AI answer quality, including whether the assistant grounds its answers in the correct documents, whether it avoids making things up, and whether it stays within its rules.
Test document upload and retrieval, confirming that an uploaded file is read correctly and can be found in later answers.
Test data isolation, confirming that one person's private conversations and data never appear in another person's session.
Write clear, reproducible bug reports developers can act on quickly.
We ask for discretion and care with confidential project material.
Requirements:
Strong interest in QA, software testing, AI tools, and automation.
Basic understanding of web applications.
Good attention to detail.
Clear written English for reports and documentation.
The ability to read product requirements and turn them into test cases.
Basic knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript.
Basic understanding of Playwright, or willingness to learn quickly.
Familiarity with browser DevTools.
The ability to test both successful and failure flows, hands-on.
Nice to have:
Playwright, Cypress, or Postman.
REST API testing.
GitHub or GitHub Actions.
Basic SQL.
Tools like Jira, Linear, or Trello.
Figma inspection, accessibility testing, or security testing basics.
Prompt or LLM testing.
Interest in AI voice products, fintech, legaltech, regtech, SaaS, or investor platforms.
What you'll learn:
AI-assisted QA workflows.
Playwright automation.
Manual and exploratory testing.
API and UI testing.
Voice and AI assistant testing.
QA documentation and bug triage.
Test planning from product requirements.
How to test complex investor, compliance, and admin platforms.
How to work with developers, product managers, and operations teams.
Ideal candidate:
Not someone who waits for instructions every minute. We need someone structured, detail-oriented, curious, and quick to learn, who can test complex workflows carefully, including an AI voice assistant. Read a requirement, design the tests, find what breaks, and document it clearly.
This suits an early-career candidate aiming to become a QA automation engineer, AI QA tester, product QA analyst, or software tester.

Adree is seeking a Quality Control, Senior Engineer responsible for ensuring product/service quality by performing inspections, tests, and audits across the production or service lifecycle. This role supports continuous improvement initiatives, leads quality documentation, and coordinates with production and other teams to address quality issues effectively.
Key Responsibilities
Perform and oversee quality inspections and testing according to established standards, work instructions, and relevant specifications
Review batch/production records to ensure compliance with quality procedures
Identify, investigate, and document quality deviations/non-conformities (NCs) and coordinate corrective actions
Conduct root cause analysis (e.g., 5 Whys, Fishbone) and support CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions)
Ensure proper use and calibration status of measuring instruments/test equipment (as applicable)
Monitor product quality trends and report findings to management
Maintain accurate and timely quality documentation (checklists, inspection reports, test records, QA logs)
Support internal/external audits by preparing documents and ensuring readiness for audit requirements
Collaborate with production/operations to improve process capability and reduce defects/rework
Train and guide junior QC team members on quality processes, inspection methods, and reporting
Requirements
4-7 years of experience in Quality Control / Quality Assurance / Inspection roles (industry-specific)
Strong understanding of quality standards, inspection methods, and documentation practices
Knowledge of CAPA, root cause analysis, and quality tools (e.g., 5 Whys, Ishikawa/Fishbone, Pareto)
Good attention to detail and ability to follow SOPs and work instructions strictly
Job Location:
Client Site

title: Platform Engineer, Automation
description:
About Us
Dorsia is at the forefront of hospitality-tech innovation, redefining how the world gains access to the most in-demand restaurants, events, and experiences. By fusing cutting-edge technology with the art of luxury hospitality, we empower our members to secure impossible-to-get reservations while providing operators with unprecedented levels of control, visibility, and revenue optimization.
In 2025, we grew revenue 480% and scaled to 400+ venues across 25 destinations, with the launch of our Culture Calendar extending Dorsia beyond restaurants into the world’s most sought-after cultural moments.
Backed by $54M in funding from investors including Index Ventures, Invus, and Red Sea Ventures, and strategic partners including MoonPay, Major Food Group, and The Dinex Group - Daniel Boulud, we are entering our most consequential phase of growth and reshaping the global hospitality landscape. We’re adding exceptional talent to drive what comes next, and that’s where you come in.
About The Role
Dorsia is seeking an
Automation Engineer
to sit at the intersection of product quality and operational intelligence. You will own two things that matter equally: ensuring our platform ships reliably through robust automated testing, and identifying the repetitive, manual, and error-prone workflows across the company that should no longer exist.
The ideal candidate is genuinely product-minded and comfortable operating across the full scope of a problem. You have a bias toward shipping, a low tolerance for toil, and a habit of asking whether something should be automated before accepting that it has to be done by hand.
What You'll Do
Product Quality and Test Automation
Design, implement, and maintain automated test suites across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers for our core products.
Own and evolve our test automation framework, including tools like Maestro, Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent API testing approaches.
Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline and keep the build signal clean and trustworthy.
Partner with Engineers and Product Managers to define and validate acceptance criteria for new features before they ship.
Monitor test runs for flakiness and failures, and drive improvements that fix them durably rather than paper over them.
Contribute to test strategy and coverage planning, with particular focus on high-risk and high-impact surfaces.
Internal Automation and Tooling
Proactively identify repetitive, manual, or error-prone workflows across the company, spanning engineering, ops, support, and GTM.
Design and implement automations using AI tools and LLMs for classification, summarization, routing, and generation; low/no-code platforms like Zapier, Make, n8n, or Retool; and lightweight Python or TypeScript scripts that connect systems together.
Use AI-assisted coding to prototype quickly, then harden promising prototypes into maintainable, observable production systems.
Integrate automations with the tools the team already relies on, including Slack, CRMs, ticketing systems, and internal APIs.
Work with stakeholders to map processes, define requirements, and iterate toward solutions that actually get used.
Reliability, Observability, and Maintenance
Ensure automations and test systems are reliable, debuggable, and documented well enough that someone else can understand and fix them.
Implement monitoring and alerting for critical automations, covering error rates, latency, and failure notifications.
Own the full lifecycle of automations: from idea through prototype, production, iteration, and eventual deprecation.
Regularly review and prune unused, flaky, or low-value automations to keep the surface area manageable.
Collaboration and Culture
Work closely with product, engineering, and operations to prioritize what to automate based on actual impact.
Communicate tradeoffs clearly, build versus buy, and automation complexity versus benefit, without waiting to be asked.
Help establish an automation-first mindset across the team, encouraging others to think in terms of systems and reusable workflows.
Share knowledge through documentation and playbooks that are clear enough for non-engineers to follow and build on.
The Winning Recipe
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
3-5 years of experience in a QA automation, software engineering, or workflow automation role.
Strong hands-on experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or equivalent.
Comfortable writing Python and TypeScript/JavaScript at a level that produces clean, maintainable, production-grade code.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and a track record of keeping build signals reliable.
Demonstrated ability to ship internal automations using low/no-code platforms, LLM-powered tooling, and scripting.
Solid understanding of APIs and how to connect systems that weren't designed to talk to each other.
Strong written communication, including documentation that is actually useful long after the sprint ends.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, complex environment involving cross-functional projects.
A genuine interest in the Dorsia product, the member experience, and what it means to build for hospitality at this level.
Strong plus: prior experience with reservation system integrations (SevenRooms, Resy, OpenTable), dining payments infrastructure, or luxury/membership consumer apps.
Compensation And Benefits
Flexible PTO
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
FSA
Commuter benefits
Free membership to One Medical
Teladoc
Talkspace
Kindbody
401(k)
In-office lunch 3 days a week
Employee Dining Credits
Salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and stage. We determine our pay by considering skills and experience related to the role, location, and ensuring internal equity relative to other Dorsia employees.
Compensation
New York Pay Range
$120,000 - $145,000 USD
Workplace Philosophy at Dorsia
At Dorsia, we believe that culture eats strategy. The best ideas in the world mean nothing without the right people around the table and the right chemistry between them. We are, unapologetically, a people-first organization.
In-Person Matters
We’re creating once-in-a-lifetime experiences for the most discerning audience in the world. That doesn’t happen over Zoom. It happens through collisions: a spark across a desk, a kitchen-side conversation that unlocks a partnership, the energy of ideas felt, not typed. That’s why in-office culture is non-negotiable at Dorsia.
Who We Hire
We don’t subscribe to check-the-box hiring. We hire for merit and mindset, which naturally creates a team with varied backgrounds. What unites us isn’t demographics, it’s a shared vision: to build the social operating system for the cultural vanguard.
Lifestyle Hours
We’re not a 9-to-5 company. Our lifestyle mirrors our members. Early flights, after-work events, and late-night sprints when the work demands it. But we love what we do, and we definitely love a good party.
High Performance Culture
Working at Dorsia isn’t for everyone—and that’s the point. Our culture is designed for builders, not passengers. We move fast, set ambitious standards, and expect people to rise to them. If you have the talent and the drive, this will be a ride to remember.
A Final Word
We’re building something special. It will take long hours and relentless effort. It’s not for everyone. For those with the metabolism, you’ll create something that changes how culture is lived. And that’s the kind of work worth your life’s energy.

Summary
The Test Automation Engineer supports XedaLink's quality practice by building, maintaining, and improving automated tests for web applications, APIs, and integrations. This hands-on role works within the automation strategy defined by QA leadership and partners with QA, product, and engineering teams to validate product quality throughout the SDLC. The successful candidate brings a strong QA foundation, practical automation experience, and the ability to translate requirements and acceptance criteria into reliable automated coverage using modern testing tools.
Essential Functions
The following is a list of essential functions, which is subject to change at any time and without advance notice. Management may assign new duties, reassign existing duties, or eliminate a function based on business needs or at its sole discretion.
Essential Duties And Responsibilities
Automation Development & Maintenance:
Develop, maintain, and enhance automated tests and supporting framework components for UI, API, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing
Execute automated test suites and support automated test integration within CI/CD pipelines as directed by QA leadership
Identify practical opportunities to expand or improve automation coverage in alignment with the QA automation strategy
Hands-On Testing & Analysis
Using testing frameworks and tools such as Selenium, Playwright, and Postman, write and maintain reliable automated tests
Debug and analyze test failures, isolate defects, and report clear issues to product and engineering for resolution
Maintain test data, test environments, and test results documentation to support release readiness
Quality Partnership

Participate in sprint ceremonies, refinement, planning, and release readiness discussions by providing quality-focused input
Collaborate with QA leadership, developers, product managers, and QA testers to support quality goals and continuous improvement

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Technology, Information Systems (CIS/MIS), Engineering or related technical discipline, or equivalent experience/training
3+ years of quality assurance experience, including 2+ years of hands-on test automation experience, preferably in a SaaS environment and/or in the financial services/fintech industry
Experience in Agile Scrum/Agile Development and automation testing methodologies with a focus on test execution, test planning, documenting test results, release and change management processes, and defect management activities
Experience with automated regression, functional, end-to-end, API, and integration testing
Hands-on experience writing automated tests in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, or Python
Hands-on experience with automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium and Playwright, API testing tools such as Postman, CI/CD test execution, and quality/observability tools such as Datadog or similar
Skills And Competencies
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an attention to detail
Self-starter who understands how to effectively deal with ambiguity and with changing priorities
Working knowledge of agile testing methodologies, concepts, and practices throughout the SDLC process
Collaborative team player with the ability to provide clear feedback, ask clarifying questions, and work across QA, product, and engineering teams to drive quality outcomes
Working Conditions

May require flexibility in hours.

Xactus promotes an equal opportunity workplace, which includes reasonable accommodations of otherwise qualified disabled applicants and team members. Please contact your supervisor with questions regarding the physical demands of this position.
Lifting/carrying up to 10 lbs.
Manual dexterity for computer work

Additional Information Regarding Employment With Xactus
If applying for a position at Xactus, candidates must be a resident of the United States, and should be authorized and eligible for employment in the United States. Xactus does not provide visa sponsorship at this time.
If hired to work at Xactus, employment is contingent upon successful completion of required background checks (including but not limited to federal and state criminal history checks, employment history verification, education verification, credit history check) and pre-employment drug screening.

title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:

Utilize tools like Playwright, Cypress, Appium, and Cucumber to ensure comprehensive coverage across web, mobile, and desktop environments.

ISTQB Advanced Level Test Automation Engineer or cloud provider certifications (AWS/Azure).

title: Test Automation Engineer
description:

Help us evaluate our test automation framework and coverage strategy

Assist us in building a culture of automation
Improve test automation in our CI/CD pipelines
Your work will not sit in a slide deck. It will show up chairside.
What You Bring
Minimum bachelor’s degree in computer science or related STEM field.
At least 3 years of experience working as a Test Automation Engineer, preferably in a regulated environment, e.g., FDA.
Excellent communication skills

description:

Position Description
Role Overview
As a Test Automation Engineer at Antero, you will play a crucial role in building SaaS products and supporting bespoke software for our clients. Reporting to the CTO, you will sit within our technology team here in Brisbane at our Fortitude Valley office, collaborating with developers, product owners, and our QA team to give us the confidence to release across our growing array of code bases.
The key to success in this role is a genuine passion for quality, clean, well-tested code, meaningful coverage, and automation that lets the whole team ship without fear. You will define and champion the “Antero way” of testing: the standards, patterns, and practices that make our test suites something the team trusts and acts on.
Core Competencies
A software development background with the ability to design, write, and maintain automated test suites across the front end and back end.
A passion for quality code, test coverage, and automation, with the judgement to know what is worth testing and how.
Ability to translate testing best practice into clear, repeatable standards, and to mentor and upskill others in applying them.
An aptitude for understanding and interpreting the logic and process that sits behind data driven technology systems and testing the parameters they should operate within.
Key Responsibilities
Release Confidence Across Our Code Bases:
Defining the “Antero Way” of Testing:
Establish and document testing standards, patterns, and conventions for our projects.
Define what good coverage looks like at each layer of the stack, and embed these standards into our day-to-day development workflow.
Upskilling and Mentoring the QA Team:
Work alongside our technical QA team to grow their automation and software development capability.
Run training, pairing, and review sessions that lift the team’s confidence in writing and maintaining automated tests.
Tooling and CI/CD Integration:
Build and maintain automated tests across TypeScript, React, Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright. Apply the same rigour across PHP, Laravel, PHPUnit, and Docker.
Integrate automated testing into our CI/CD pipelines (Buddy and GitHub) so tests run reliably as part of every change.
Keep test suites fast, stable, and trustworthy, so results are believed and acted on rather than ignored.
Communication and Documentation:
Document standards and present them clearly to the wider technology team.
Communicate coverage, gaps, and quality risks to developers, product owners, and the CTO using Jira and Confluence.
Quality Assurance Methodology and Best Practices:
Contribute to and continuously improve Antero’s quality engineering methodology and best-practice framework.
Stay ahead of industry trends in test automation and bring better ways of working back to the team.
A Little About Us
Antero is a SaaS product and bespoke software provider which is part of the Flip Group, including weareflip our creative agency partner, and Khemistry, our behaviour change partner. Antero develops its own SaaS products specific to FinTech and financial markets in addition to providing software consultation and bespoke software development for our clients. Our flagship product Incept is used by several Asset Finance companies within Australia providing a FinTech platform in a box to accelerate loan origination, credit decisioning, settlements, doc gen, etc.
Our Workplace
we have a development team alongside a highly talented creative team, keeping the work interesting and of incredible quality
we have a hybrid work from home policy usually 3 or 2 days in the office, but we are flexible
we offer training opportunities for staff who are interested in upskilling
we’re a genuinely good bunch of folks with an interest in high quality results
we’re growing year on year
our office is a plant-filled oasis with amazing food and coffee a stone’s throw away
this is the place to do good work and learn new things
What else can I expect from this role?
In addition to the core responsibilities, the Test Automation Engineer may engage in performance and load testing to evaluate the scalability and responsiveness of our platforms, analysing results and recommending improvements. You may help shape how we use AI tooling such as Claude to write, review, and accelerate testing, and continuously identify and implement process improvements while staying updated with industry trends. As the most senior testing voice in the team, you will mentor QA team members and lead training sessions on new tools, techniques, and standards.
How do I know if I qualify for this role?
Capability in this role will be measured through the following activities:
Demonstrating hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining automated test suites across a modern web stack.
Showcasing a software development background, including familiarity with TypeScript/React and PHP/Laravel ecosystems, developer tooling, and CI/CD pipelines.
Writing or reviewing automated tests for a given feature, explaining your coverage decisions and the trade-offs behind them.
Walking us through how you would introduce and document a testing standard, and how you would bring an existing team along with you.
If this sounds like your kind of place the next steps for you to follow are:
email a copy of your CV / Portfolio / GoPro video to careers@antero.com.au
within a few days you’ll receive a tech test which helps us to better understand your skill level and where you’ll fit in the team
for those who successfully complete the tech test you will receive an interview where we can discuss your results and where you might fit within our team

We are looking for an active learner who is ready to get out of the comfort zone and bring the state-of-the-art testing to the team. We want you to challenge our ways of thinking and bring new ways of looking at quality to our team
This is not a maintenance role. It is a builder role. You will work alongside engineers, clinicians, operators, and AI scientists to solve practical problems for dental teams on the ground. You will help create the platform that replaces the patchwork of disconnected tools.

Help us evaluate our test automation framework and coverage strategy
Significantly increase our test coverage across product lines, especially from a backend and API testing perspective

Improve test automation in our CI/CD pipelines
Your work will not sit in a slide deck. It will show up chairside.

Excellent communication skills

Experience integrating tests with a CI/CD pipeline
Most importantly, you care about building technology that improves people’s health.

We win and lose together as one team. Collaboration is not a buzzword here. We share context early, ask for input, and step in to help when someone is stuck.
We hold a high bar, but we stay grounded. We move fast, learn as we go, and stay focused on what matters most for clinicians and patients.

The opportunity to work on AI that is actually used every day

description:

HIL Simulation Engineer
for the

to strengthen our real-time simulation laboratory.
In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will focus on the validation and grid compliance certification of utility-scale BESS and PV inverters using real-time simulation platforms. You will serve as a key technical expert and bridge between regional teams, global R&D, Control Engineering, Technical Marketing, and Grid Compliance groups. A major part of the role involves using the regional lab to reproduce on-site issues, coordinate with headquarters, and drive timely technical resolutions.

Technical Leadership & Grid Compliance
Design, develop, and maintain
CHIL and PHIL test environments
using real-time simulation platforms.
Lead verification and certification activities for BESS and PV inverter controls to comply with major international grid codes (IEEE 1547, VDE-AR-N 4110/4120, EREC G99, NEM, etc.).
Develop and validate dynamic plant models, including inverter models, battery models, and Power Plant Controller (PPC) logic.
Drive test automation using Python or similar tools to improve efficiency and repeatability.
Serve as a high-level technical escalation point for complex control, communication (Modbus, DNP3, IEC 61850), and grid interconnection issues.
Reproduce and analyze on-site problems in the regional lab, coordinate with headquarters, and ensure timely closure of technical issues.
Lead end-to-end execution of regional semi-physical grid simulation projects and customer delivery projects.
Cross-Functional & Technical Marketing Support
Generate
simulation-backed data and reports
to support technical marketing, white papers, and brand authority.
Host laboratory visits and deliver real-time HIL demonstrations to customers, utilities, and key stakeholders.
Collaborate with Sales and Technical solution engineering teams to provide expert technical input during bidding and project phases.
Laboratory Technical Support
Perform hands-on
testing and validation
work in the state-of-the-art real-time HIL laboratory.
Support efficient scheduling and utilization of test resources to meet project deadlines.
Provide technical input on hardware/software needs and platform enhancements.
Requirements
Education & Experience
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Control Systems, or a related field.
5+ years
of hands-on experience in
real-time simulation, HIL testing
, or inverter/BESS control validation.
Demonstrated technical leadership on complex projects (strong individual contributor with influence).
Technical Expertise
Strong proficiency with real-time simulation platforms and the
ability to build, run, and troubleshoot complex models
.
Deep understanding of utility-scale PV inverters and BESS operation, control strategies, and grid behavior.
Extensive experience with international grid codes and interconnection requirements (fault ride-through, voltage/frequency support, power quality, etc.).
Strong programming skills in Python, C/C++, MATLAB/Simulink for test automation and model development.
Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (Modbus TCP/RTU, DNP3, IEC 61850).
Preferred / Bonus
Experience with plant-level (station-level) semi-physical simulation models.
Joint commissioning experience with third-party systems such as EMS or SVG.
Exposure to multiple real-time simulation platforms.
Language Requirement
Candidates must be
fluent in either English or Chinese
. Bilingual proficiency in both is a strong advantage.
Travel Requirement

Why Join Sungrow?
This is a high-impact technical role in a growing regional lab focused on real-time simulation technology. You will work at the forefront of renewable energy grid integration, combining deep simulation expertise with real customer projects and global collaboration.
If you are a technical expert ready to bridge the gap between regional execution and headquarters strategy, we want to hear from you.

title: Vehicle Technician | Dubai, UAE
description:
About Moove
Moove is building the world’s largest fleet and best-in-class technologies to power mobility platforms. Our flagship Drive-to-Own (DTO) product democratises access to vehicle ownership with a revolutionary revenue-based financing model, enabling underserved mobility entrepreneurs to thrive.
Our global growth has been fuelled by our partnership with Uber and backed by leading investors and lenders, including Uber, Mubadala, BlackRock, and many others. Today, Moove operates the world's largest manned & autonomous ride-hail fleet, with 38k+ vehicles across 29 cities, 13 countries and 6 continents enabled by 2.1k+ employees – Moove continues to expand through strategic partnerships with industry leaders like Uber. We’re transforming mobility to be safer, more efficient, and accessible to all, while creating economic opportunities and supporting skills development in the mobility sector.
About The Role
As a Vehicle Technician, you are the specialist eyes on our autonomous vehicle sensor stack and mechanical assembly. You will inspect, test, and validate the hardware components that make our vehicles see and think; Lidar, Radar, cameras, and compute units as well as the physical mounting systems, wiring harnesses, and mechanical assemblies that hold everything together and ensure every system meets operational and safety standards before deployment.
This is a junior to mid-level hands-on technical role specializing in the inspection, testing, and quality assurance of AV self-driving system hardware and its mechanical integration. You will work closely with engineering staff and the AV Safety Manager to identify hardware defects, validate sensor performance, check mechanical integrity, document findings accurately, and support root cause analysis when issues arise. You are not a software engineer but you understand how hardware behaves, how to test it methodically, and how to flag when something is wrong.
What You’ll Be Doing
Hardware Inspection and Validation
Conduct structured inspections of AV self-driving system hardware including Lidar, Radar, cameras, ultrasonic sensors, and compute units
Verify correct installation, alignment, physical condition, and connectivity of all sensor hardware following defined inspection checklists and partner SOPs
Perform functional hardware checks and sensor readiness validations as part of the pre-deployment clearance process
Conduct post-repair hardware inspections to confirm defects have been correctly resolved before vehicle redeployment
Assess impact of environmental conditions heat, dust, humidity on sensor hardware performance and flag anomalies
Mechanical Inspection and Assembly Integrity
Inspect all sensor mounting hardware brackets, fasteners, clamps, and vibration isolators for correct installation, torque, and physical condition
Verify cable routing, strain relief, and connector seating across the full sensor wiring harness, flagging any chafe, pinch, or unseated connection
Check enclosure seals, gaskets, and IP rated fittings to ensure ingress protection against dust and moisture critical in Dubai operating conditions
Perform post-maintenance underbody and chassis-level inspections to confirm no mechanical disturbance from prior service activity
Identify and escalate loose, corroded, or fatigued mechanical components before they cause sensor misalignment or vehicle downtime
Maintain a structured mechanical inspection log alongside hardware QA records so both disciplines are traceable in the fleet maintenance system
Testing and Characterization
Execute defined hardware performance tests and bench characterization procedures to verify sensor output against acceptance criteria
Support calibration procedures for Lidar, Radar, and camera systems in accordance with partner technical standards
Operate onboard diagnostic tools and software interfaces to assess hardware health and data quality
Document test results accurately using 4Cs standards (Condition, Cause, Correction, Confirmation) in the fleet maintenance management system.
Defect Management and Escalation
Identify, document, and escalate hardware defects and sensor anomalies through the defined non-conformance process
Track open hardware issues including mechanical defects through to resolution; verify corrective actions before closing
Identify recurring hardware failure patterns and surface structured findings to engineering staff and the AV Safety Manager
Support post-incident technical reviews where hardware performance is a contributing factor
Compliance and Safety
Adhere strictly to high-voltage safety, lockout/tagout, and hazardous material handling protocols at all times
Follow mechanical safety protocols when working around high-torque fasteners, suspension components, and vehicle undercarriage including correct use of vehicle lifts and jack stands
Maintain audit-ready hardware inspection and test records
Ensure all hardware QA activities, electronic and mechanical, comply with partner technical standards and UAE regulatory requirements
What You Will Need For This Position
Diploma or bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field preferred
2 to 5 years of experience in hardware testing, electronics QA, light mechanical maintenance, or AV/automotive technical operations
Hands-on experience with optical, electrical, or sensor hardware preferred; Lidar or Radar familiarity a strong advantage
Practical experience with mechanical assembly, fastener systems, torque tools, and basic vehicle maintenance even from an automotive, aerospace, or industrial background
Comfortable operating diagnostic tools, software interfaces, and onboard vehicle systems
Strong attention to detail; methodical and thorough in inspection, testing, and documentation
Basic data analysis skills; comfortable working with test outputs, logs, and performance data
Able to lift and carry assemblies exceeding 25 kg and stand for extended periods
Valid UAE driving license preferred
What Does Success Look Like
All AV hardware inspected and validated to standard before every deployment
Defects identified early, documented accurately, and resolved completely
Recurring hardware issues surfaced to engineering before they become operational problems
A sensor stack that performs reliably because the QA bar never moves
Mechanical assemblies are consistently in spec no deployment is delayed by a loose mount, failed seal, or unseated connector that should have been caught at inspection
Who You'll Be Working with:
Directly reporting to our Fleet Operations Manager, and closely working with our Operations Team.
About The Team
Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.

Moove relies on the accuracy of information contained in employment applications, as well as the accuracy of other data presented throughout the hiring process and during employment. Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.
EEO Statement:
Moove is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, political affiliation or any other protected characteristic.

Our team is redefining how quality assurance is built. We leverage Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and intelligent automation to reimagine the entire testing lifecycle—from test design and execution to bug analysis, quality evaluation, and engineering productivity. Our mission is to build next-generation AI-powered testing capabilities that enable faster, smarter, and more scalable software delivery. Joining our team and working at the intersection of Software Engineering, Quality Engineering, and Generative AI, helping shape the future of AI-native software testing at TikTok.
As a Software Test Engineer (AI), you will:
- Design and develop AI-powered testing solutions that improve software quality and engineering efficiency across the entire software development lifecycle.
- Work on quality and engineering efficiency initiatives leveraging LLMs, including change risk analysis, automated testing, search quality evaluation, and LLM security testing.
- Identify quality and engineering efficiency pain points in collaboration with software and algorithm engineering teams, propose practical optimization solutions, and drive their implementation to improve product quality and engineering efficiency.
- Stay up to date with the latest advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) and AIGC technologies, explore innovative quality and engineering efficiency solutions for software testing, and continuously refine them through practical application.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
- Experience in software quality assurance or software testing, preferably for mobile applications, backend services, or distributed systems.
- Solid understanding of software testing methodologies, debugging, and quality assurance best practices across the software development lifecycle.
- Familiarity with distributed systems and fundamental knowledge of iOS and/or Android platforms.
- Experience with one or more testing domains, including automation testing, performance testing, or test platform/tool development.
- Strong interest in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), with an understanding of common LLM capabilities and real-world application scenarios.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional and global teams.
- Passion for building high-quality products and driving end-to-end quality assurance through AI-powered testing technologies.
Preferred Qualifications
- Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, Go, or Objective-C.
- Experience developing test automation frameworks, testing platforms, or engineering productivity tools.
- Familiarity with distributed infrastructure and cloud-native technologies such as Redis, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, Hive, Spark, NSQ, or ZeroMQ.
- Hands-on experience with AI-related projects, including LLM application development, AI agent evaluation, model evaluation, AI-assisted testing, or AI testing frameworks.
- Experience leveraging AI tools (e.g. LLMs, AI coding assistants, or AI agents) to improve testing efficiency, automate test case generation, bug analysis, or software quality workflows.
About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​
Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

title: Clinical Quality & Patient Safety Officer
description:
Job Summary
The Clinical Quality & Patient Safety Officer is responsible for developing, implementing, and monitoring programs and processes that ensure the delivery of safe, effective, and high-quality clinical care. The role ensures compliance with regulatory requirements, internal quality standards, and best practice guidelines, while fostering a culture of safety, learning, and continuous improvement across all clinical services.

Quality Management & Clinical Governance
Develop and maintain a clinical quality management framework aligned with national regulations, accreditation standards, and company policies.
Oversee the creation, review, and implementation of clinical policies, protocols, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Conduct regular audits of clinical documentation, patient records, and service delivery to ensure compliance with quality standards.
Monitor performance indicators and prepare quality reports for senior management.
Patient Safety
Lead the development and implementation of patient safety initiatives to minimize risks and prevent adverse events.
Manage incident reporting systems, investigate patient safety incidents, and coordinate root cause analyses (RCA).
Develop corrective and preventive action (CAPA) plans to address identified risks.
Promote a culture of transparency, accountability, and open communication regarding safety issues.

Ensure all clinical practices comply with Ministry of Health regulations, professional licensing requirements, and telemedicine standards.
Prepare for and facilitate external inspections, audits, and accreditation processes.
Maintain updated knowledge of relevant healthcare regulations and patient safety guidelines.
