Design and deliver training programs for clinical staff on quality improvement, patient safety, and risk management.
Provide guidance and support to healthcare providers on adherence to best practice guidelines.
Promote continuous professional development to improve clinical competency and quality outcomes.
Data Analysis & Reporting
Collect and analyze clinical quality and safety data to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
Produce monthly, quarterly, and annual reports on key quality and safety metrics.
Present findings and recommendations to leadership teams.
Education
Qualifications and Experience:
Bachelor’s degree in Medicine, Nursing, Pharmacy, or other healthcare-related field (required).
Master’s degree in Healthcare Quality, Patient Safety, Public Health, or equivalent (preferred).
Experience
Minimum 3–5 years of experience in clinical quality management, patient safety, or healthcare governance.
Experience in telemedicine or digital health services is an advantage.
Familiarity with national and international accreditation standards (e.g.,CBAHI, JCI).
Key Skills And Competencies
Strong knowledge of quality improvement methodologies (PDSA, Six Sigma, etc.).
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Strong communication and training facilitation skills.
Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.
High attention to detail and commitment to ethical practice.

title: QA & Training Lead — Building Systems Data
description:
About the role
Robotic Imaging delivers facilities and equipment reporting for a US client base that includes Fortune 500 retailers, using 3D laser scanning, VR, and AI-driven data extraction. Our Dubai office runs the production and quality backbone behind that work.
We're hiring a QA & Training Lead to own quality and technical competence across our Data Extraction & Operations (DEO) team of ~50 technicians working across two shifts and two platforms. This is not a queue-management or delivery role — it is a knowledge, training, and quality role. Your mission is to turn a large production team into building-systems experts who QA their own and each other's work, so quality is built into every deliverable rather than caught by a single reviewer at the end.
You'll work in close daily contact with our US site team, joining calls at the start of the US East Coast business day to align priorities and set the tone for the next production cycle.
What you'll own
Building-systems knowledge.
Maintain the authoritative reference and train the team across HVAC, Electrical, Gas, Water & Plumbing, Fire Protection, Refrigeration, and Roof — including component identification, nameplate/asset data capture, survey-value calculations (tonnage, amperage, service sizes), and equipment-age decoding.
Platform mastery.
Be fluent in both of our platforms (Firebase and Supabase), know which is used for which client and deliverable, and teach technicians to move between them without confusion.
Training program.
Design and run onboarding and ongoing training for ~50 technicians across day and night shifts — modular curriculum, worked examples, competency checks, and weekly micro-training on the current top error trend.
Certification.
Assess and certify technicians to self-QA and then to peer-QA, building a distributed QA model that removes the single-gatekeeper bottleneck.
Quality standards.
Own the data-tech checklists and the accuracy bar; keep SOPs current across reporting, VR tagging, site surveys, and AI asset-extraction review.
Metrics & continuous improvement.
Track first-pass QA rates, rework rates, and error type by system; report trends and convert the top recurring error into targeted training.
Error catalog.
Maintain a living list of common mistakes and their fixes, and feed them back into the curriculum.
What you'll bring
Strong working knowledge of commercial building systems — MEP, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire, refrigeration — ideally from a BIM, MEP, facilities, surveying, or building-services background.

title: QHSE Officer
description:
Job Overview
The QHSE Officer will support the implementation, monitoring, and continual improvement of the company's quality, health, safety, and environmental systems. Working closely with the HSE & FM Manager, HSE and operational teams, the officer will help maintain safe working conditions, regulatory compliance, and the effective implementation and maintenance of the ISO 9001 Quality Management System. The role includes conducting risk assessments, inspections and audits, investigating incidents and nonconformities, and promoting a culture of quality, safety, and environmental responsibility.
Key Responsibilities for this position include but are not limited to:
Quality Management:
Assist the HSE & FM Manager in implementing, maintaining, and continually improve the ISO 9001 Quality Management System in coordination with relevant process owners.
Maintain QMS documentation, process maps, objectives, risks and opportunities, records, and performance indicators.
Coordinate internal audits, management reviews, nonconformities, corrective actions, and certification audits.
Health and Safety Management:
Support the HSE & FM Team in developing, implementing, and enforcing QHSE policies and procedures.
Conduct regular risk assessments, safety audits, and inspections.
Identify hazards, recommend corrective actions, and ensure compliance with safety protocols.
Provide training and awareness sessions to ensure staff adherence to safety standards.
Manage contractor activities and Permit to Work (PTW) and Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) systems to ensure safety compliance.
Incident and Risk Management:
Investigate incidents and near misses, documenting findings and implementing corrective actions.
Support the HSE & FM Manager in improving safety systems based on risk assessments and incident trends.
Emergency Preparedness:
Collaborate on developing and reviewing emergency response plans and procedures.
Conduct emergency drills, ensuring all employees are prepared for potential hazards.
Ensure fire and safety equipment is maintained and fully operational.
Compliance and Reporting:
Maintain accurate records of QHSE inspections, incidents, quality nonconformities, audits, and training sessions.
Assist in preparing reports for internal audits, management, and regulatory permits, approvals, or licences.
Support compliance with applicable quality, health, safety, environmental, legal, customer, and ISO requirements.
Collaboration and Support:
Work closely with Operations, Maintenance, and other relevant stakeholders to improve QHSE performance.
Engage with employees at all levels to promote quality, safety, and environmental awareness.
Stay updated on best practices and industry standards to continually improve the QHSE programme.
Qualifications And Skills
Bachelor's degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field.
NEBOSH IGC certification in Occupational Health and Safety is mandatory.
ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor certification is required.
First Aid and Fire Safety certifications are desirable.
ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certification or strong working knowledge is desirable.
Additional certification in quality, health, safety, or environmental management is an advantage.
4–5 years of combined QHSE experience, preferably in a manufacturing, service, laundry, or other process-driven environment.
Proven practical experience implementing and maintaining an ISO 9001 QMS, including controlled documentation, internal audits, nonconformities, corrective actions, management reviews, and certification support.
Experience in hazard identification, risk assessment, HSE inspections, incident investigation, training delivery, rootcause analysis and QHSE report writing.
UAE Driving License Mandatory
Skills
Fluency in English; additional languages are a plus.
Strong communication, analytical, organisational, problem-solving, and follow-up skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
Good to have knowledge of tools such as Notion, Asana, Slack, or similar platforms for collaboration and task management.
Working Conditions
Exposure to various operational environments, including possible exposure to heat, noise, and chemicals.
Occasional travel may be required for site inspections or meetings.

Why Join Us?
Be part of a fast-growing and innovative digital laundry company.
Work in a dynamic and forward-thinking environment focused on sustainability and employee well-being.
Opportunities for growth and career advancement.
Competitive salary and benefits package will be offered based on qualifications, skills and experience.
If you are passionate about quality, health, safety, and environmental improvement and want to make a difference in a forward-thinking company, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to join our team at Washmen.

title: Quality Assurance Manager
description:
Core Job Summary
The QA/QC Manager establishes, implements, and maintains the quality assurance systems and inspection protocols across all stages of production—from raw sheet metal receipt to the final painted and assembled enclosure—ensuring zero-defect delivery to clients. Also architects, enforces, and audits the plant's Quality Management System (QMS) to satisfy ISO 9001 and international structural steel and welding code metrics
The QA/QC Manager is responsible as well for the overall quality, structural integrity, and cosmetic finish of custom and standardized sheet metal enclosures. The role requires an analytical leader with deep technical knowledge of fabrication tolerances, welding standards, paint finish metrics, and final assembly compliance who can proactively prevent defects and resolve customer quality issues.
Key Responsibilities
In-Process Inspection Standards:
Establish and enforce Go/No-Go criteria for each production stage: flatness and dimensions after laser and CNC cutting, bend angles and tolerances at the press brakes, and weld integrity.
Paint & Finish Validation:
Oversee rigorous testing on the powder coating line, including dry film thickness (DFT) checks, cross-hatch adhesion tests, gloss level measurement, and color-matching audits.
Final Assembly Audit:
Implement rigorous final inspection protocols for enclosure seals, hardware alignment (hinges, latches, PEM fasteners), ingress protection (IP/NEMA ratings) consistency, and overall cosmetic perfection.
Defect Root Cause Analysis:
Lead investigations into internal non-conformances and customer returns using structured problem-solving tools to implement permanent corrective actions.
Supplier Quality Management:
Inspect and approve incoming raw materials (sheet steel, powder paint chemicals, gaskets, electronic components….etc)
Equipment Calibration:
Manage the calibration schedule for all precision measurement tools, including vernier calipers, height gauges, paint thickness meters
Certification Maintenance:
Maintain the facility’s quality certifications (such as ISO 9001) and lead internal and external quality audits.
Required Qualifications
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or Manufacturing Engineering.
Experience:
5+ years of Quality Management experience specifically within precision sheet metal fabrication or enclosure manufacturing.
Technical Knowledge:
High level knowledge of geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, blueprint reading, AWS welding inspection standards, and powder coating testing methods. Active AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) is mandatory
Language:
Strong command of English or Arabic.

title: QA Analyst
description:
About Sienci Labs
At Sienci Labs, we build software that empowers people to create, collaborate, and innovate. Our tools are used by a growing community of developers, businesses, and creators around the world. We're a small, fast-moving team that thrives on solving real-world problems through clean code, smart engineering, and a relentless focus on quality.
About the Role
We're looking for a sharp, detail-oriented QA Analyst who brings hands-on CNC experience to the table. This role is not just about testing code—it's about being the bridge between our software development team and other departments (customer support, product, manufacturing, sales, etc.).
You will proactively reach out to these teams to uncover bugs, understand how our software behaves in real CNC workflows, and ensure issues are caught early and communicated clearly. If you understand how CNC machines operate, how operators think, and how software can break in the real world, we want to talk to you.
What You'll Be Doing
Act as a liaison between the software development team and other departments (support, product, manufacturing, sales) to identify, prioritize, and document software bugs.
Proactively communicate with non-technical teams to gather real-world bug reports and usage feedback.
Write and maintain unit tests and automated test suites for our Electron, React, Node.js, and TypeScript stack.
Use Jira to track tasks, report bugs, and collaborate with developers.
Reproduce, document, and escalate bugs found in CNC-related software workflows.
Perform manual and automated testing across desktop (Electron) and web applications.
Help improve QA processes to catch issues earlier in development, especially those related to CNC toolpath generation, machine control, or user interface.
Keep test documentation up to date and advocate for best practices in testing.
What We're Looking For
CNC experience – required (you understand G-code, toolpaths, machine setup, and common failure modes in CNC workflows).
Knowledge of CNC firmware, specifically GRBL and GRBLHAL – strongly preferred (candidates with this experience can dive deeper into debugging and root cause analysis right away).
Experience with software QA methodologies and defect tracking.
Proficiency with Jira for task management and bug reporting.
Strong skills in unit testing frameworks (Jest, Mocha, etc.) and test automation.
Familiarity with our stack: Electron, React, Node.js, TypeScript.
Ability to work independently, troubleshoot issues, and propose solutions.
Clear communication skills – you can explain technical issues to developers, non-technical staff, and customers alike.
A proactive mindset – you don't wait for bugs to be reported; you seek them out from other teams.
Nice to Have
Experience with end-to-end testing tools (Cypress, Playwright, Selenium).
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests.
Background in customer-facing bug triage (working with support teams).
Experience with CAM software or other CNC controller software (e.g., Mach3, LinuxCNC).
Education & Experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience) – preferred.
3+ years in QA/testing roles (preferred).
2+ years in software development environments (preferred).
CNC experience – required.
GRBL/GRBLHAL knowledge – strongly preferred.
Why Work at Sienci Labs?
You'll be part of a tight-knit team where your work has a direct impact on thousands of users. You'll help shape how our software interacts with real-world CNC machines, and you'll be the voice connecting development to the rest of the company. Clean code, smart testing, continuous improvement—and no bureaucracy.

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
About Teifi
Teifi Digital, a Shopify Plus Platinum partner, excels in resolving complex e-commerce challenges. We focus on integrating large catalogs, sophisticated data frameworks, and legacy systems into seamless unified commerce and B2B solutions, delivering unparalleled customer experiences. Our skill in deploying Shopify Plus caters to top-tier merchants in manufacturing, parts, distribution, retail, and B2B, ensuring minimal technical debt and maximized e-commerce revenue.
An AI-Forward Workplace
AI is embedded in how we work. Our team regularly uses AI tools to enhance productivity, streamline processes, and deliver better outcomes. Candidates joining us should be comfortable leveraging AI as part of their day-to-day workflow and open to developing their skills as these tools evolve. Familiarity with AI tools is a plus; a willingness to learn and adapt is a must.
As part of our hiring process at Teifi Digital, any offer of employment is conditional upon the successful completion of a background check.
Role Overview
We are seeking a QA Analyst with a strong background in ecommerce testing to ensure the quality, reliability, and production-readiness of all client deliverables across Teifi Digital's Shopify Plus engagements. QA will work within a delivery pod, collaborating closely with Engineering Leads, Business Analysts, and Project Managers to define test strategies, validate acceptance criteria, and enforce quality gates from sprint execution through to go-live. This is a hands-on, detail-oriented role operating in a fast-paced agency environment where projects span complex e-commerce builds, platform migrations, and custom integrations.
Key Responsibilities
Test Planning & Strategy
Define the overall test strategy for each engagement, tailoring the approach to project scope, complexity, and risk profile.
Create comprehensive test plans that outline testing phases, scope, timelines, entry/exit criteria, and resource requirements.
Apply a risk-based testing approach, prioritizing test effort toward high-impact areas to maximize coverage within delivery timelines.
Own test environment readiness, verifying that environments are correctly configured — feature flags enabled, settings aligned to production — coordinating with engineering to resolve infrastructure dependencies such as CI/CD pipelines and data seeding.
Test Design & Execution
Write and maintain test cases that thoroughly cover functional requirements, edge cases, and user journeys.
Manage the test case repository, ensuring cases are versioned, organized, and reusable across projects and sprints.
Execute QA testing across all phases of delivery, from feature-level validation through to end-to-end integration testing.
Conduct sanity testing after deployments and code changes to rapidly confirm that critical functionality is intact before broader test cycles begin.
Perform smoke testing pre- and post-deployment, validating that builds are stable enough to proceed to deeper testing or release.
Execute regression testing to confirm that new changes have not introduced defects into existing functionality.
Carry out cross-browser and cross-device testing, ensuring consistent user experiences across supported platforms and screen sizes.
Perform accessibility testing to verify compliance with accessibility standards and inclusive design requirements.
Review design artifacts including wireframes and high fidelity mockups to identify issues early
Plan and execute performance testing — including page load times and basic throughput validation.
Defect Management & Quality Reporting
Track and manage bugs through the full defect lifecycle, from identification through to resolution and verification.
Triage and report defects with clear severity classification, reproduction steps, and supporting evidence to enable efficient resolution.
Monitor and report on defect rates, establishing metrics that inform project quality assessments and drive process improvement — including defining the tooling and processes needed to capture this data systematically.
Produce test coverage reports, providing stakeholders with visibility into what has been tested, current coverage levels, and outstanding risk.
Maintain QA documentation and reporting, ensuring that test outcomes, known issues, and quality metrics are clearly communicated to the wider delivery team.
Release Readiness & Go-Live
Provide sprint QA sign-off, formally confirming that all deliverables within a sprint meet the required quality bar before they progress.
Enforce the Definition of Done, holding the team accountable to agreed quality standards and ensuring no work is marked complete without passing QA gates.
Own and execute the go-live QA checklist, providing a structured final quality gate before production deployment.
Conduct post-launch validation, verifying that the deployed solution works as expected in the production environment — accounting for environment-specific differences such as DNS, CDN, live payment gateways, and third-party integrations.
Cross-functional Collaboration
Partner with Business Analysts on acceptance criteria validation, ensuring that requirements are testable, unambiguous, and fully covered by the QA effort.
Participate in design and architecture reviews where relevant, contributing a quality and testability lens during early project phases to surface potential risks before they reach implementation.
Partner with the Engineering Lead on release readiness, coordinating release planning — including timing, dependencies, risk assessment, and go-live readiness validation — and ensuring QA sign-off is complete before deployment proceeds.
Execute go live QA checklist in coordination with delivery pod and support performance testing in collaboration with the Systems Architect.
Partnering with engineering, who provide load testing tooling and handle deeper infrastructure-level performance engineering
Qualifications
3+ years of experience in Quality Assurance within a digital agency, software development, or e-commerce environment.
Experience testing complex web applications, ideally within Shopify Plus or other modern e-commerce platforms (including API integrations, third-party applications, payment gateways, and ERP/OMS integrations).
Strong understanding of software development lifecycles (SDLC), Agile delivery methodologies, and sprint-based development workflows.
Proven experience creating and executing comprehensive test plans, test cases, and regression testing strategies.
Hands-on experience with functional, regression, smoke, sanity, integration, cross-browser, cross-device, and accessibility testing.
Familiarity with accessibility standards and best practices (WCAG).
Comfortable working within staging, QA, and production environments and understanding deployment/release workflows.
Experience using defect tracking and project management tools such as Jira, ClickUp, Linear, or similar platforms.
Ability to interpret business requirements and translate them into clear, testable acceptance criteria.
Exposure to performance testing tools and methodologies is considered an asset.
Experience with test automation frameworks or automation tooling is considered an asset, though this role is primarily focused on manual QA.
Exceptional attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document issues and communicate risk to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Highly organized and able to manage multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced agency environment.
A proactive mindset with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and commitment to delivering high-quality client experiences.
Benefits & Perks
Ongoing professional development through training programs, certifications, and peer mentorship.
Hybrid work model depending on role, with a Granville Island office and free on-site parking.
Flexibility in work hours designed to accommodate appointments and personal responsibilities.
Comprehensive health and dental coverage in Canada, plus a health spending account.
Paid office closure between Christmas and New Year’s.
Regular team culture events, stocked office snacks, and a dog friendly workplace.
Performance based bonus opportunities for full-time employees.
We are an equal opportunity employer and love diversity at our company! We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

65,000 - 80,000 CAD per year(Canada)

The wage for this position is: $7,458 per month to start (equivalent to $89,496 per year) and then progressing up to $8,409 per month.
Job Summary
Under the broad managerial direction of the Assistant Manager and/or Manager, and as an active member of a self-organized work team, collaborates collectively in the planning, design, testing, execution and delivery stages of technology-driven products and services that meet the needs of the business and deliver value. Acts as subject matter expert during the testing stages of product/service delivery to ensure system functionality is consistent with defined business product/service requirements. Researches and evaluates new test tools and upgrades to determine their applicability to PBC’s testing environment. Maintains a resource library of test plans and scripts. To support the team, may consult with third party vendors, members and other teams from a Quality Assurance Analyst perspective as determined through team collaboration. Maintains required proficiency levels in technical skills and core competencies consistent with the established framework for the position and pursues continuing self-development associated with the rapid pace of change within the industry.
Job Duties
Self-Organized Work Team Member
As an active member of a self-organized work team and through group cooperation, shared processes and team problem solving, collaborates collectively in the planning, design, testing, execution and delivery stages of technology-driven products and services that meet the needs of the business and deliver value by:
defining and expanding on the design features, components and overall priorities communicated by business stakeholders;
estimating size and complexity of the work, and as a group, assessing team capacity to complete the work, determining achievable goals for each stage and identifying out of scope activities;
articipating in team discussions and coming to consensus on who will complete the work, and identifying in-house resources including network, database, architecture, deployment, security, production or other subject matter experts necessary to support team success;
collaborating regularly with all team members throughout all stages of the work to track team progress, problem solve roadblocks and interdependencies, and identify options for enhancing stakeholder value in upcoming stages of the work;
committing to and delivering on individually assigned activities and tasks within established time frames, as determined by the team as a whole;
preparing and delivering informal presentations to the team and/or key stakeholders on technical design elements, demonstrations of challenges encountered in any stages of design or delivery, options for team and stakeholder feedback and consideration, and any other aspects where team collaboration can contribute to the quality, timing or effectiveness of shared outcomes;
applying technical, professional, organizational and industry quality standards to meet or exceed delivery goals throughout all stages of the work;
contributing to the smooth flow of communication between all team members and stakeholders;
collectively assessing release and deployment status, and determining timing and activities required to deliver products into production;
participating in retrospectives and sharing in the evaluation of delivery outcomes at the conclusion of each stage of the work, recognizing and celebrating successes, developing action plans for incorporating past or current experiences and new learnings into future team initiatives, and pursuing opportunities for continuous improvement;
transferring knowledge to team colleagues in specific areas of individual expertise to increase team efficiency and operation, capitalize on opportunities for growth and development, and increase team engagement;
liaising with stakeholders throughout all stages of the work to identify and facilitate the removal of barriers to successful team delivery; refers challenges outside of the team’s influence to resources external to the team‘s day to day operation;
on an occasional basis, participating as a team in member communication processes such as focus groups to ensure understanding of the overall member experience with PBC products and services as they relate to the team member’s area of subject matter expertise.
Testing Services
Provides testing expertise and acts as subject matter expert during the testing stages of product/service delivery to ensure system functionality is consistent with defined business product/service requirements by:
consulting with other internal and external business stakeholders to define and understand business requirements and design features that will determine the scope of testing;
defining overall test approach, strategy, test entry and exit criteria, and related metrics aligned with testing goals and priorities;
preparing time, resource allocation and scheduling estimates;
creating, designing and documenting manual and/or automated test plans and scripts to validate system functionality within a test environment;
conducting system, functional, regression, automated and load testing;
creating, selecting and loading test data and executing test plans and scripts;
editing test scripts during execution where results differing from the predicted test outcomes occur, and conducting further investigation and analysis to determine the potential source of testing variances and resolve bugs, errors, configuration issues and interdependency flaws associated with the testing process;
identifying unexpected outcomes during testing by verifying system output, narrowing variances to testing or non-testing sources, and consulting with Software Developers and other technical team members on corrections and potential improvements to system or program design from a testing perspective;
identifying pass/fail status and documenting test results including reconstruction of test failures, and making recommendations concerning the outcome of deficit failures to the team;
tracking testing progress in relation to expected outcomes and providing regular status and metrics reports to the team;
overseeing strict adherence to internal controls throughout testing to maintain established audit trails.
Researches new test tools and upgrades to determine their applicability to PBC’s testing environment, evaluates their effectiveness and degree of fit, and makes related recommendations for purchase and/or installation.
Maintains a resource library of test plans and scripts for potential future application to similar or recurring test applications.
Additional Technical Functions Assigned Through Team Collaboration
May consult with third party vendors, members and other teams from a Quality Assurance Analyst perspective to determine interdependencies and potential/actual barriers associated with their application to the business.
General Team and Department Support
Through continuous learning initiatives, maintains up to date knowledge of testing strategies and tools, testing materials and design such as test automation, systems design concepts, tools, security requirements, operating systems, end-user business products/services specific to PBC’s user environment, general technology trends and other information related to the provision of testing services to users. Maintains required proficiency levels in technical skills and core competencies consistent with the established framework for the position and pursues continuing self-development in the maintenance and enhancement of technical skills and core competencies associated with the rapid pace of change, through the application of a variety of learning options, online self-service platforms, in-house support, skills assessment and other learning and development tools.
Conducts ongoing review of technical materials related to changes in in-house products/services from a technology perspective. Conducts online research and participates in information exchanges with colleagues and technical contacts, including membership in testing-related technology resource groups.
Participates in semi-annual disaster recovery exercises by conducting regression testing for specific business applications in consultation with Database Administrators and members of the disaster recovery team.
Performs other assigned duties related to the provision of system testing services and team operation which do not affect the rating of the job.
Qualifications
2 year diploma in computer systems technology such as BCIT’s Computer Information Technology (CIT) with program options in Applied Software Design/Quality Assurance Testing, Technical Programming, Web and Mobile or Database (or equivalent program) which in addition to technology courses includes foundational courses in:
Business Communication

Formal training leading to certification in Agile practitioner level skills and knowledge (eg SAFe Practitioner course (14 hours) or equivalent industry-recognized Agile course(s) )
Demonstrated critical thinking skills gained through the successful application of problem solving methods such as problem analysis, logic and judgement
Minimum 4 years previous related experience in a testing/quality assurance position (or equivalent) including a minimum of 2 years experience in a medium to large sized organization, working on medium to large scale projects.

The Functional Test Analyst is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and business readiness of ERP and digital transformation solutions within a power utility environment. Working within Agile teams, the analyst partners with business stakeholders, developers, and project teams to validate business requirements, execute testing activities, and support successful solution delivery.
This role will be 4 days per week on client site in downtown Halifax.

Develop and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts for functional, regression, integration, E2E, UAT, and accessibility testing.
Participate in Agile ceremonies, requirements reviews, and Three Amigos sessions to ensure testable requirements and clear acceptance criteria.
Perform web, UI, API, interface, and data validation testing.
Manage defects through their lifecycle using Azure DevOps or similar tools, including triage, tracking, retesting, and reporting.
Support ERP transformation initiatives, including Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP or similar enterprise platforms.
Collaborate with business SMEs, product owners, developers, and project teams to validate end-to-end business processes and integrations.
Execute UAT activities and support business readiness and release validation.
Monitor quality metrics and contribute to continuous improvement of testing practices.
Leverage GenAI tools such as GitHub Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot to enhance test design, documentation, and productivity.
Required Qualifications
5+ years of experience in functional testing, QA, or ERP testing.
Experience testing web applications, APIs, integrations, and enterprise systems.
Strong understanding of testing methodologies, test case design, defect management, and QA best practices.
Experience working within Agile/Scrum teams.
Proficiency with Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar testing and defect management tools.
SQL and data testing experience.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP or similar ERP platforms.
Experience in regulated industries such as utilities, energy, or the public sector.
Knowledge of utility business processes, including finance, procurement, asset management, or work management.
Exposure to ITIL and service management practices.
Programming knowledge (TypeScript preferred) and familiarity with test automation concepts.
Oracle or QA-related certifications are considered an asset.

Our expansive and growing network empowers seamless access to a comprehensive range of travel options and services globally with over $750 million transactions annually - all at the industry’s best rates.
As an industry leader in technology, purchasing, finance, HR and marketing, we know how to deliver solutions to travel professionals in the most effective way possible. With deep experience in partnering with two leading brands in the luxury travel space – Kensington Tours and Travel Edge – TripArc has real insight into the needs of tour operators and travel agencies today.
TripArc’s
goals are simple. To make our network of over 1400 travel entities more profitable, efficient and help them create truly unique travel for their clients.
This is a hybrid role with a minimum of 2-days a week at our office located in Downtown, Toronto.
About TripArc
TripArc builds and operates the technology platform that powers travel agencies and advisor networks across North America. Our platform is complex, our pace is fast, and quality assurance sits at the heart of everything we deliver.
We're looking for a
Senior QA/QA Analyst
to join our team in a hands-on senior individual contributor role. This is an opportunity for someone who is passionate about test automation, quality engineering, and software testing craftsmanship while mentoring other QA professionals.
As the Senior/QA Analyst, you will own the automation strategy within your delivery pod by designing and maintaining Playwright/TypeScript automation frameworks, executing deep manual and exploratory testing, and helping establish a high technical standard across the QA team. You'll work closely with Developers, Product Owners, and the QA Manager while providing mentorship and guidance to QA Analysts.
The ideal candidate brings deep, hands-on expertise with Playwright and TypeScript—the primary automation framework used across the team—not simply experience with multiple testing tools. You'll also be comfortable incorporating Claude or comparable AI-assisted development and testing tools into your daily workflow to improve efficiency and testing quality.
Key Responsibilities
Test Automation (Playwright & TypeScript)
Design, build, and maintain automated test suites using Playwright and TypeScript.
Own the automation architecture for your product area, including page objects, reusable utilities, fixtures, test data management, and reporting.
Continuously expand automation coverage across UI, API, regression, and end-to-end testing.
Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to provide fast, reliable feedback throughout the development lifecycle.
Troubleshoot failed automated tests and distinguish product defects from automation or environment issues.
Continuously improve automation maintainability, scalability, and reliability.
AI-Assisted Quality Engineering
Use company-approved AI tools, including Claude, to accelerate test case creation, automation development, code review, and defect investigation.
Apply sound engineering judgment when validating AI-generated code and test coverage.
Share effective AI-assisted testing practices and workflows across the QA team.
Manual & Exploratory Testing
Perform detailed manual and exploratory testing for complex functionality and scenarios not yet automated.
Create well-structured test plans and test cases using Xray.
Execute functional, integration, regression, system, and exploratory testing.
Perform API testing using Postman and validate application data through SQL queries.
Document defects in Jira with clear reproduction steps, environment details, and expected versus actual results.
Collaboration & Mentorship
Partner closely with Developers, Product Owners, and the QA Manager to define quality strategy early in the development lifecycle.
Review test cases and automation contributions from QA Analysts while providing coaching and technical mentorship.
Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release readiness discussions, representing the QA perspective.
Assess quality risks and communicate recommendations clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
Qualifications
5+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance with significant ownership of test automation.
Strong hands-on experience with Playwright and TypeScript (required).
Experience designing and maintaining UI and API automation frameworks.
Strong understanding of automation architecture, design patterns, reusable test frameworks, fixtures, page objects, and test data management.
Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
Experience testing REST APIs using tools such as Postman.
Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Experience using Git, pull requests, branching strategies, and source control workflows.
Experience working with Jira, Confluence, Xray, or similar Agile delivery tools.
Strong understanding of Agile software delivery methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban.
Strong defect investigation and root cause analysis skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Hands-on experience using Claude or comparable AI-assisted development and testing tools as part of the testing and automation workflow.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Additional Assets
Experience with Selenium WebDriver or other automation frameworks.
Experience working within travel technology, booking platforms, or other complex distributed software ecosystems.
Experience working across multi-pod Agile delivery teams.
Previous experience mentoring or coaching QA Analysts.
We provide a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. Employees have the opportunity to participate in incentive programs and compensation tied to business and individual performance. The expected
base
compensation range for this position is: $80,000 to $90,000.
The actual compensation may vary depending on local market conditions, geography and relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualifications, experience, and education/training.
We are committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. If you require accommodation due to a disability at any stage of our hiring process, please advise us when completing your application.
The Range Group may use artificial intelligence throughout the recruitment process to screen, assess or select applicants for this position. These tools assist our hiring team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
We thank all candidates for their interest however only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Dock Quality Analyst
description:
Description
Join the Armour Team Today!
The
Dock Quality Analyst
is responsible for monitoring, analyzing, and improving key operational quality measures within the warehouse and dock environment. This role supports consistent execution of dock processes by reviewing key performance indicators, identifying quality issues, and working with operations teams to improve load factor, scanning compliance, seal quality, and load securement. The position plays an important role in maintaining operational accuracy, freight integrity, and service reliability.
Location
: Moncton, NB
Schedule
: Monday - Friday | 7:00am - 5:00pm
Type
: In-office
What You'll Do
Monitor and report on scanning compliance to ensure freight is accurately tracked throughout dock operations.
Review load factor performance and identify opportunities to improve trailer utilization and operational efficiency.
Audit load securement practices to confirm freight is properly protected and secured before departure.
Conduct seal time auditing and review seal quality to support shipment integrity and process compliance.
What You Bring
Previous experience in warehouse, dock, transportation, logistics, or freight operations is preferred.
Experience reviewing operational reports, key performance indicators, audit results, or quality control data is considered an asset.
Strong working knowledge of dock processes, freight handling, load securement, scanning procedures, and seal compliance is preferred.
Demonstrated ability to identify process gaps, document findings, and support corrective actions.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, with the ability to track, organize, and summarize operational information.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with dock, warehouse, and operations teams.
High attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced operational environment.

title: Quality Assurance Analyst 2
description:
Overview
We are seeking a full-time
Quality Assurance Analyst 2
at Garmin's U.S. headquarters in the Greater Kansas City area. In this role, you will be responsible for working with software development and aeronautical database teams to ensure compliance to regulatory and internal standards through device testing and support activities, the release of database updates, conducting software quality assurance activities, and preparing certification documentation.
Essential Functions
Support high-level software product and/or database process testing as needed
Participate in the maintenance of software and/or database standards, templates, and forms
Draft RTCA DO-200 certification documents and can apply deviations to the standards and process when applicable
Review software and/or database documents for accuracy and compliance, including the review of system level software parts such as loader cards
Analyze aeronautical data for completeness and accuracy
Review and find issues with RTCA DO-200 deliverables
Collaborate and add value to aviation database and/or software processes and certification
Draft internal documentation to facilitate inter-team collaboration and efficiency
Leverage process expertise with product development teams to provide reliable, repeatable and efficient SW and data releases
Provide solutions to a variety of problems using sound problem solving techniques
Work cooperatively with Engineering teams to negotiate resolutions for issues found in SQA functions
Support OEM and certification authority audits
Serve as a mentor to less experienced Software and/or Database Analysts
Collaborate effectively with product teams to accomplish goals with Garmin’s best interest in mind
Understand and comply with Garmin’s Mission, Vision, Values and Quality Policy
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration or another related field AND a minimum of 1 year relevant experience OR an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
Excellent academics (minimum 3.0 cumulative GPA as a general rule) with the demonstrated ability to apply learned knowledge
Must possess experience in technical writing, software quality, or other SW development supporting role
Demonstrate proficient use and knowledge of tools designed for engineering document management
Demonstrate proficient use and knowledge of established software standards and procedures
Must be detail-oriented with the ability to maintain and deliver a high level of quality and accuracy
Demonstrated strong and effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
Must be team-oriented, possess a positive attitude and work well with others
Excellent time management and follow-up skills
Superior organizational and analytical skills with keen attention to detail and quality
Demonstrates ability to complete well defined basic tasks and/or projects
Demonstrates proficiency using Microsoft Word and Excel
Demonstrates sense of urgency, commitment, and focus on the right priorities in developing timely solutions
Consistent demonstration of quality and effectiveness in work documentation and organization
Desired Qualifications
Experience with RTCA DO-200/DO-330 standards
Experience in software planning/development/verification
Experience with JIRA or other software issue and project tracking software
Experience with data query languages like SQL or JQL
Outstanding academics (cumulative GPA of 3.5 or greater)
Experience with aeronautical data
Pilot experience
